about.en: BELIEVE is the token of Believe, Ben Pasternak's Solana platform for launching tokens from social posts. It is the SPL token at BLVxek8YMXUQhcKmMvrFTrzh5FXg8ec88Crp6otEaCMf, which replaced Launch Coin (LAUNCHCOIN, mint Ey59PH7Z4BFU4HjyKnyMdWt5GGN76KazTAwQihoUXRnk) through a 1:1 swap in October 2025. The old mint still trades on-chain at a fraction of BELIEVE's price, so it is a different asset; unrelated tokens also use the BELIEVE ticker.
